items.title: Autonomous verification commands cannot run under the deployment OS sandbox
items.description: (1) `just test` (zig build test): a fresh project-local package cache needs downloads from deps.files.ghostty.org, which is not on the sandbox network allowlist (403 via proxy). (2) `just swift-test` / xcodebuild: fails under the OS sandbox even with repo-local DerivedData/TMPDIR/result bundle (added as `just check swift`): XPC service connections (build/log/simulator services) and writes to the per-user darwin temp dir are denied, ending in 'Could not resolve package dependencies: permissionDenied'. Both are deployment-level constraints (I-029 sandbox config), not project code issues. Every Essence success gate (just build-app / just test / just swift-test) is affected.
items.resolution: Human resolved R-001 with option (c): ESSENCE.md now declares `profile: unsandboxed` and the deployment was re-initialized without the OS sandbox (META.md §11.5). Verified this cycle: `just test` exit 0, `just swift-test` exit 0 (TEST SUCCEEDED, 410 tests incl. 14 GroupNoteTests), `zig build` (body of `just build-app`) exit 0.

items.title: Remote split needs the OSC 7 host, which the upstream terminal core discards
items.description: src/termio/stream_handler.zig reportPwd validates the OSC 7 host with internal_os.hostname.isLocal and returns early for a non-local host, so a remote pane's pwd report never reaches the app layer at all; even a local report is forwarded to Swift as a bare path string (apprt .pwd action -> SurfaceView.pwd: String?), with no host component. The macOS app and action layers therefore cannot observe that a pane is remote, which is exactly the case the Essence's must-62 and 思想 3 reserve for the human: do not enter the core, consult instead. Blocks S-074/S-075/S-076/S-077 (must items 60-62) and their human verification S-078.
items.resolution: Resolved by the human's R-013 resume decision (option (a), 2026-08-16T02:19:06+09:00): the minimal upstream-core change is explicitly approved, scoped to carrying the OSC 7 host + path to the app layer. Implemented this cycle exactly within that scope - reportPwd forwards a non-local report instead of dropping it, pwd_change carries path + host, apprt.action.Pwd and xghostty_action_pwd_s gained host, and the Swift receive path keeps it in SurfaceView.pwdReport. Local reports and VT semantics are unchanged: a non-local report still never becomes terminal.setPwd, the window title, or SurfaceView.pwd. Gates green (zig build / just test / just swift-test = exit 0, 569 tests). T-049 and T-050 are done; what remains for S-074/S-075/S-076 is the human on-device check S-078 (T-055).
